items.title: Eric Alexander interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, March 31, 2010
items.q: people like Lee Morgan and Hank Mobley wrote ninety percent of the music on their records

ctx.x: Okay. Well there’s a good reason to write.

That’s one of the reasons that people like Lee Morgan and Hank Mobley wrote ninety percent of the music on their records, and thank God they were incredible writers. And by contrast this is also one of the problems today, everyone wants their mechanicals and everyone thinks they’re a good writer, and most people aren’t. So we see records coming out where you look at it and you say, you know what’s coming, it’s a bunch of stuff that’s not really memorable. So I’m kind of torn. And the last few records I’ve…

Nice. And I agree with what you’re saying. Like you did the tune “It’s Magic,” and it’s exactly what you’re saying when I saw that I go he did “It’s Magic”? Like and then I start to sing the song in my head and I go wow, what an interesting choice. I can’t wait to hear what you did with that.
